origin.basicoriginsbackground.child_of_t: You was a child born in the street and you had learned how to survive
origin.basicoriginsbackground.equestrian: You are an equestrian that have a horse
origin.basicoriginsbackground.royal_guar: As a former royal guard, you will therefore have combat advantages thanks to your inventory.
origin.basicoriginsbackground.lumberjack: As a former Lumberjack, you can start with the axe inventory, which will give you a huge advantage.
origin.basicoriginsbackground.miner.name: Miner
origin.basicoriginsbackground.miner.desc: As a former miner, you know the caves well, so you'll be able to reach them more quickly at the start.
origin.basicoriginsbackground.bandit.des: You are an bandit that have a bandle and a iron sword
origin.basicoriginsbackground.former_sol: You are an former soldier that have a shield and a iron sword
origin.basicoriginsbackground.chef.name: Chef
origin.basicoriginsbackground.chef.descr: You are an chef that cook for everyone
origin.basicoriginsbackground.farmer.des: You are an famer that have some sheep and a iron hoe
origin.basicoriginsbackground.black_smit: You are an black smith that have some iron ingot and a smithing table
origin.basicoriginsbackground.bard.name: Bard
origin.basicoriginsbackground.bard.descr: You are a bard and you start with a lute
origin.basicoriginsbackground.engineer.d: You are an engineer that have a goggles and a wrench
origin.basicoriginsbackground.wizard_app: As an apprentice wizard, you will gain easier access to magic with a starter pack focused on Iron Spells.
origin.basicoriginsbackground.shepherd.d: As a former shepherd, you still retain the benefits of that past, and this will be evident in both your inventory and your surroundings.
power.basicoriginsbackground.pocket_full: Your pocket is full of things that will maybe help you in your adventure or maybe not
power.basicoriginsbackground.horse.name: Horse
power.basicoriginsbackground.guard_inven: With the guard's inventory, you'll have the chance to start with an iron chestplate, giving you a huge advantage when defending yourself or someone else.
power.basicoriginsbackground.axe_invento: The Axe Inventory gives you an iron axe right at the start of the game, allowing you to gather wood much faster than others.
power.basicoriginsbackground.pickaxe_inv: Thanks to the pickaxe inventory, you will start with an iron pickaxe, giving you a huge advantage early in the game.
power.basicoriginsbackground.pocket_full: You get a bandle and a iron sword
power.basicoriginsbackground.soldier_inv: You get a shield and a iron sword
power.basicoriginsbackground.cook_invent: You get a furnace and a porkchop
power.basicoriginsbackground.sheep.name: Sheep
power.basicoriginsbackground.engineer_in: You get a wrench and a goggles
power.basicoriginsbackground.wizard_inve: In the wizard's inventory, you will start with a wizard's hat, which will make you feel like one, as well as a basic grimoire that allows you to cast spells once you find them.
power.basicoriginsbackground.shepherd_in: Thanks to the shepherd's inventory, you will have wheat directly in your inventory, as well as some companions, three sheep, to do with as you please.
